description: Technical viability review (#2017, Epic #2011 Phase 6). Answers whether the declared technical premises — runtime, API, library, performance, security, compatibility — hold, and never whether a technology is preferable. Viability is judged on evidence: what can be established mechanically is established by deterministic-check before any model judgment runs, every candidate verdict passes verify-findings, and a premise whose evidence lies outside the supplied artifacts leaves the run through human-escalation as an open question instead of reaching derive-gate as a verdict.

inputs.name: design
inputs.description: The design carrying the technical premises under review.

inputs.name: diff
inputs.description: Code that already exercises the premises. Optional: absence skips the premise-versus-code cross-check.

inputs.name: tests
inputs.description: Test evidence for performance and compatibility premises. Optional: absence degrades those judgments to declared-only and records the degradation.

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Requirements the premises must support. Optional: absence skips the premise-versus-requirement cross-check.

steps.description: Mechanical evidence first: whether a declared dependency exists in the repository, whether a version range resolves, whether a referenced interface is present. Degrades when the check cannot run, so a missing mechanical answer never becomes a model-asserted one.
Existing upstream-phase selection; no Flow-local list.
Declared premises against the design that declares them. Degrades to a premise-only judgment when the supporting test evidence is absent.
Declared premises against the requirements they must support.
Declared premises against the code that already exercises them.
Evidence requirement: a viability verdict that cites nothing in the supplied artifacts does not survive this step.

A premise whose evidence lies outside the supplied artifacts is handed to a person as an open question rather than decided. Degrades to recording the open question when no escalation channel is available.
